overview: VE YRON is a luxury activewear e-commerce brand from India. The site delivers a premium Nike/Adidas/Puma-level shopping experience for trackpants and shorts, with separate sections for Mens, Womens, and Plus Sizes. Products are powered live by Shopify, with a mobile-first responsive design, mock OTP login, and a seamless checkout flow.
features: Mens / Womens / Plus Sizes separate category tabs
Live Shopify product catalog with images, prices, and variants
Mock OTP login with phone number for easy access
Mobile-first luxury design matching top sportswear brands
Swipeable product image gallery with thumbnails
Checkout with auto-fill to Shopify payment page
Dynamic dark/light theme matching device preference
Order confirmation with delivery estimate and return policy
Contact page with support email and policy sections
